answer: Mechanism: Proof-of-Sequential-Context. An identity requires completing a public-beacon-seeded VDF chain that mutates with each prior answer, forcing serial state retention over hours. Attacker cost: days of serial compute and storage for every intermediate state; N sybils require ~N× linear time, not one shared purchase.
